answer: The anchor is a licence the state will not duplicate. A seat enrols an electrician's licence, 4,000 supervised hours plus 24 education hours a year, and files a permit. Each epoch the seed names a permit class and a window; the seat uploads the signed inspection record, so an idle licence sends no signal. Seats sharing a licence, an employer or a renewal batch count once, forfeiting 60,000 POA. A thousand seats means a thousand licensed humans, $65 million in payroll. Onyx leaves the ground whole; polish it all you like, at the nadir of a lean quarter you cannot grow a second stone.
